import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" terracotta = "#C66B4E" grid_color = "#E5EAE8"
A = np.array([[2, 1], [0, 1]], dtype=float) e1 = np.array([1, 0], dtype=float) e2 = np.array([0, 1], dtype=float) v = np.array([1, 1], dtype=float) a1, a2, Av = A @ e1, A @ e2, A @ v square = np.array([[0, 0], e1, v, e2]) parallelogram = square @ A.T
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.8, 4.2)) left = fig.add_axes([0.065, 0.18, 0.265, 0.66]) right = fig.add_axes([0.505, 0.18, 0.475, 0.66])
def setup_plane(ax, xmax, xticks): ax.set_xlim(-0.28, xmax) ax.set_ylim(-0.83, 2.38) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.set_axis_off()
for x in xticks: if x > 0: ax.plot([x, x], [0, 1.7], color=grid_color, linewidth=0.8, zorder=0) ax.plot([0, xmax - 0.1], [1, 1], color=grid_color, linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
for endpoint in [(xmax - 0.03, 0), (0, 1.83)]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (-0.17, 0) if endpoint[1] == 0 else (0, -0.18), endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, linewidth=1.0, color=slate, zorder=2, ))
for x in xticks: ax.plot([x, x], [-0.035, 0.035], color=slate, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3) ax.text(x, -0.15, rf"${x}$", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10, color=slate) ax.plot([-0.035, 0.035], [1, 1], color=slate, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3) ax.text(-0.13, 1, r"$1$", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=10, color=slate)
def vector(ax, endpoint, color, linestyle="-", width=2.1): ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=13, linewidth=width, linestyle=linestyle, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=5, ))
setup_plane(left, 1.8, [0, 1]) setup_plane(right, 3.45, [0, 1, 2, 3])
for ax, vertices in [(left, square), (right, parallelogram)]: ax.add_patch(Polygon( vertices, closed=True, facecolor=teal, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.11, zorder=1, )) ax.plot( vertices[[1, 2, 3], 0], vertices[[1, 2, 3], 1], color=slate, linewidth=1.2, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)), zorder=3, )
vector(left, e1, blue) vector(left, e2, teal) vector(left, v, terracotta, width=2.3)
left.text(0.65, -0.36, r"$\mathbf{e}_1$", color=blue, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=14) left.text(-0.13, 0.56, r"$\mathbf{e}_2$", color=teal, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=14) left.text(1.10, 1.12, r"$\mathbf{v}$", color=terracotta, ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=14)
vector(right, a1, blue) vector(right, a2, teal) vector(right, Av, terracotta, width=2.3)
right.text(1.55, -0.36, r"$\mathbf{a}_1$", color=blue, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=14) right.text(0.73, 1.12, r"$\mathbf{a}_2$", color=teal, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14) right.text(3.02, 1.13, r"$\mathbf{A}\mathbf{v}$", color=terracotta, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14) right.text(1.55, -0.68, r"$\det(\mathbf{A})=2$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13)
mapping_arrow = FancyArrowPatch( (0.355, 0.535), (0.475, 0.535), transform=fig.transFigure, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=14, linewidth=1.5, color=ink, ) fig.add_artist(mapping_arrow) fig.text(0.415, 0.565, r"$\mathbf{A}$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=15)
